lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Two hundred and ninety megawatts. Decay twelve a wave. This is the last anchor on the order that will still take a shutter.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Say the rest of it, Control.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: The shutter is bolted from this side. It cannot be set remotely and it cannot be set from the far side. Somebody has to be on the deck when it closes.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Actual wants it stated that this is a volunteer tasking.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: It's stated. Hold the brief there, I've got a board to build.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact. Everything the order describes, all at once.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor fifty-two reports holding. Okonkwo says the water is still fine.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Ceiling?

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One ninety-six and falling on schedule.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, the wardens on the far side of the ring have stopped moving. All of them, at once.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: They're out of power.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: They have been out of power for a hundred and ten years, Captain.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Shutter crew is off the deck. Charges are set. It closes on your word and not before.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead. One wave on the board.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Bus is over. There is nothing left to shed that is not holding the ring.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through. It did not stop at the ring.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, the ring is failing. Say the word and I will close it with you inside.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Every ward engaged. Last ring Meridian lights on this order.
lines.beat: no triumph in it — stated flatly, same tone as everything else Control reads

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Shutter is set. Anchor is closed from this side.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Sixty anchors remain on the order. Meridian holds four of them.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, acknowledge.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Meridian Actual, standing by.
lines.beat: Vasquez has no line after the last wave. Control asks twice and the game ends on the silence.
